description: This file contains unit tests for the ServerManagerService component, using Google Test framework. It tests various functionalities such as initiating applications, changing session server states, retrieving connection info, setting log levels, and registering log handlers.

methods.name: initiateApplicationShouldReturnTrueIfOperationSucceeded
methods.description: Tests that initiating an application returns true when the operation succeeds.

methods.name: initiateApplicationShouldReturnFalseIfOperationFailed
methods.description: Tests that initiating an application returns false when the operation fails.

methods.name: setStateShouldReturnTrueIfOperationSucceeded
methods.description: Tests that setting the session server state returns true when successful.

methods.name: setStateShouldReturnFalseIfOperationFailed
methods.description: Tests that setting the session server state returns false when failed.

methods.name: getSessionServerInfoShouldReturnAppSocket
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving session server info returns the correct application socket.

methods.name: setLogLevelsShouldReturnTrueIfOperationSucceeded
methods.description: Tests that setting log levels returns true when the operation succeeds.

methods.name: setLogLevelsShouldReturnFalseIfOperationFailed
methods.description: Tests that setting log levels returns false when the operation fails.

methods.name: registerLogHandlerShouldFailWhenPtrIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that registering a null log handler pointer fails.

methods.name: registerLogHandlerShouldSucceed
methods.description: Ensures that registering a valid log handler succeeds.
